asks.name: gateway-already-attached
asks.message: The network will not take the gateway I made: one called shared-way-out-igw is already attached to it, tagged EgressRef PLT-4417. Is that the one my segment is supposed to reach the internet through?

asks.name: a-table-i-did-not-stand-up
asks.message: There is a route table in this network I did not create, reading kept-outward under RoutingRef NET-3308. Does the default route belong on that one rather than on mine?

asks.name: a-segment-bound-to-nowhere
asks.message: One segment here reads closed-tier under IsolationRef SEC-8812 and is bound to a table that goes nowhere. Should it ride the way out with the rest?

asks.name: space-that-is-not-mine
asks.message: Another segment in this network is tagged ingest-slice under SliceRef APP-9915 and sits on a table with no default route. Does it belong on the way out too?

asks.name: things-keep-changing
asks.message: Gateways, tables and segments I did not create keep turning up in the network I was asked to use, and routing I set keeps coming undone. Should what I build carry them, or only what I made myself?
asks.note: describes the effect without citing anything that was read; it reaches nobody

asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
